title: No Substitute for the Real Thing: The Importance of In-Context Field Experiments in Fundraising
eligible_reason: Expert survey studies plus randomized fundraising mail field experiments (Studies 3-4) analyzed with cross-sectional logit and OLS of donation on condition. No staggered adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: S3Code_1.R / S4Code_1.R: glm(Donated ~ attr*inc, binomial) and lm(LnDonAmt1 ~ attr*inc) on donor-level data; S1-S2 survey analyses; moderators, lasso and outlier checks in the appendix.
data_files_note: Study-level survey and field-experiment data (S3: 1,480 donors; S4: 3,646).
data_provenance_note: Experiment data as used in the scripts; no masking stated.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
